Why giants could not exist.

Goal: I can use k, k^2, k^3 for lengths, areas, and volumes.

slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
If two solids are similar with scale factor k, corresponding lengths are in ratio k, surface areas in ratio k2, and volumes in ratio k3.

A giant 10 times as tall as a person would weigh 1,000 times as much (volume), but the cross-sectional area of the leg bones that hold the weight would be only 100 times as much. Each square centimeter of bone would carry 10 times the load, which is why giants could not exist with human proportions.
